{
  "name": "pi-bifrost",
  "version": "0.5.0",
  "description": "Route Pi turns through models you choose, with configured tiers and opt-in per-request dispatch.",
  "files": [
    "*.ts",
    "bifrost.json",
    "schema.json",
    "examples/",
    "CHANGELOG.md"
  ],
  "type": "module",
  "license": "MIT",
  "author": {
    "name": "Aamir",
    "url": "https://github.com/iamaamir"
  },
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/iamaamir/pi-bifrost.git"
  },
  "homepage": "https://iamaamir.github.io/pi-bifrost/",
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/iamaamir/pi-bifrost/issues"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "pi-package",
    "pi-extension",
    "model-router",
    "model-routing",
    "developer-tools",
    "llm",
    "ai",
    "coding-agent"
  ],
  "pi": {
    "extensions": [
      "./index.ts"
    ],
    "minPiVersion": "1.0.1",
    "image": "https://iamaamir.github.io/pi-bifrost/social-card.png"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "test": "node --test --experimental-strip-types \"tests/*.test.ts\" \"tests/*.test.mjs\"",
    "test:integration": "node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/integration/*.test.mjs",
    "test:ui": "python3 scripts/ui-smoke.py",
    "test:ui:agent-tui": "bash scripts/ui-smoke-agent-tui.sh",
    "test:ui:reliability": "bash scripts/ui-reliability-fake-provider.sh",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "lint": "tsc --noEmit",
    "benchmark:jev": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/jev-benchmark.ts",
    "release": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/release.mjs"
  },
  "peerDependencies": {
    "@earendil-works/pi-ai": "*",
    "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent": "*"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@earendil-works/pi-ai": "1.0.1",
    "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent": "1.0.1",
    "@types/node": "^26.1.1",
    "agent-tui": "^1.1.0"
  }
}
